Refresh device battery, thermal, and memory telemetry
Usage Access Required for App Insights
Android requires explicit user consent in Usage Access Settings to display foreground screen time and app standby buckets. Data stays 100% on-device.

Android exposes the real battery thermistor via BatteryManager and OS thermal throttling state via PowerManager (Android 10+). Standard non-root apps cannot read raw CPU die temperature or physically cool hardware.
Android manages memory automatically. Closing or force-stopping cached apps does not improve battery life and can increase power draw when apps reload.
